description: Generic drag-and-drop Kanban board with typed items, configurable columns with optional color and WIP limits, optional horizontal swimlanes, custom card/column/swimlane templates, cross-column and cross-lane moves, in-column reordering with a visual drop indicator, collapsible columns and swimlanes whose collapsed zones stay drop targets, and events for card moves and clicks. Mouse drags through HTML5 drag and drop, touch drags through the shared pointer-drag helper (a long-press starts the drag; a cancelled gesture rolls back and is announced), and every card is also a focusable, keyboard-operable move target (WCAG 2.5.7): a "Move…" menu on the card offers every column × swimlane destination, collapsed zones included, plus Move up / Move down, and reports the same OnItemMoved / OnItemReordered contract as a drop.

parameters.name: Columns
parameters.description: Column definitions.

parameters.name: Items
parameters.description: All items on the board.

parameters.name: ColumnSelector
parameters.description: Function to determine which column an item belongs to.

parameters.name: CardTemplate
parameters.description: Template for rendering a card.

parameters.name: OnItemMoved
parameters.description: Fires when a card is dragged to a different column or swimlane. The event carries the target position (TargetIndex / TargetBeforeItem) and, when swimlanes are enabled, FromSwimlane / ToSwimlane.

parameters.name: OnItemReordered
parameters.description: Fires when a card is dropped within the same cell (same column and, if enabled, same swimlane) to change its position. When no handler is attached, same-cell drops are a no-op.

parameters.name: OnCardClick
parameters.description: Fires when a card is clicked.

parameters.name: SwimlaneSelector
parameters.description: Groups cards into horizontal swimlanes. Returning null places an item in the trailing "no value" lane. When null the board renders without swimlanes (classic layout).

parameters.name: Swimlanes
parameters.description: Explicit swimlane definitions (order and titles). When null the lanes are derived from SwimlaneSelector in order of first appearance. Ignored when SwimlaneSelector is null.

parameters.name: SwimlaneHeaderTemplate
parameters.description: Custom swimlane header template.

parameters.name: SwimlanesCollapsible
parameters.description: Whether swimlanes can be collapsed/expanded via a toggle. Defaults to true.

parameters.name: ColumnsCollapsible
parameters.description: Renders a collapse/expand toggle in every column header (classic and swimlane layouts). A collapsed column becomes a narrow strip showing the title, card count and WIP badge, renders no cards, and stays a drop target that appends the dragged card. The toggle is never part of ColumnHeaderTemplate. Defaults to false (classic markup).

parameters.name: CollapsedColumns
parameters.description: Host-owned set of collapsed column ids. null (the default) keeps the state inside the board; a host set wins and a toggle only raises CollapsedColumnsChanged.

parameters.name: CollapsedColumnsChanged
parameters.description: Fires with the complete new collapsed-column set when a column toggle is used, so @bind-CollapsedColumns round-trips. An uncontrolled board also applies the new set itself.

parameters.name: CollapsedLanes
parameters.description: Host-owned set of collapsed swimlane ids. The trailing "no value" lane is addressed with TmKanbanBoard<TItem>.NoSwimlaneId. null (the default) keeps the state inside the board.

parameters.name: CollapsedLanesChanged
parameters.description: Fires with the complete new collapsed-lane set when a swimlane toggle is used, so @bind-CollapsedLanes round-trips. The "no value" lane is reported as TmKanbanBoard<TItem>.NoSwimlaneId.

parameters.name: ColumnHeaderTemplate
parameters.description: Custom column header template. When supplied it replaces the default header content (title/count/WIP badge).

parameters.name: EmptyColumnTemplate
parameters.description: Template rendered inside an empty column/cell in place of the default "no items" text.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class.

parameters.name: Disabled
parameters.description: Whether the kanban board is disabled (prevents drag).

parameters.name: VirtualizeCards
parameters.description: Opt-in vertical card virtualization. When true, each (non-swimlane) column body becomes a fixed-height scroll container that renders only the visible window of cards through Blazor's built-in <Virtualize> — so a column holding thousands of cards stays fast. The card markup/template is unchanged. Defaults to false, which keeps the exact classic @foreach rendering (fully backward compatible).

parameters.name: CardItemSize
parameters.description: Estimated card row height (px) handed to <Virtualize ItemSize> when VirtualizeCards is enabled. Defaults to 88.

parameters.name: ShowMoveMenu
parameters.description: Whether every card offers the non-drag "Move…" action: a focusable card with ONE roving tab stop per cell (Tab reaches it, M / Alt+ArrowDown open the menu, Enter / Space raise OnCardClick), the menu of every column x swimlane target (the cell the card sits in is marked "(current)" and disabled), Move up / Move down and the live-region announcement of the result. Defaults to true because a drag-only card fails WCAG 2.5.7. false restores the pre-2.11 card markup (inert drag plus the card click, no wrapper, no tab stop, no aria attributes, no live region) — see the CHANGELOG migration note. The action is never rendered while Disabled.

parameters.name: CardLabelSelector
parameters.description: Optional function that names a card for assistive technology. The "Move …" trigger, the move menu's sheet title, the current cell's menu entry and the live region's "{0} moved to {1}" announcement read it. Prefer setting it: when null the item's ToString() is used only if the item's type overrides it (a record's generated ToString() names its fields); a plain class or struct would print its type name, so the board uses the localized "card {n}" (the card's 1-based position in its cell) instead.

notes: The board is a pure view over the host's list: it never inserts, removes or reorders an item, it reports KanbanMoveEvent and the host applies the move. Prefer TargetBeforeItem over TargetIndex when persisting order — it is unaffected by whether the dragged item is removed before or after the insertion point is computed.

A drop on a zone (header, padding, empty area, a collapsed strip or a collapsed lane's slot) appends: TargetIndex equals the cell's card count and TargetBeforeItem is null. The horizontal __drop-indicator line is drawn only by an expanded column.

Collapsing is view state. A collapsed column narrows to the --tm-kanban-collapsed-width strip (vertical title, count, WIP badge, no card body) and stays a drop target that appends; a collapsed swimlane renders .tm-kanban__swimlane-slots with one .tm-kanban__lane-slot per column instead of dropping its body, so every (column, lane) drop keeps working. Every slot names its (column, lane) target in title/aria-label (TmKanban_LaneSlotTarget) and carries the column's colour strip (.tm-kanban__slot-color). Disabled keeps the collapse but leaves every drop zone inert.

Column colours: the component renders KanbanColumn.Color verbatim (inline background-color of .tm-kanban__header-color / .tm-kanban__swimlane-color) and invents no default. Pass a token reference — the recommended palette is --tm-kanban-column-backlog/-todo/-doing/-review/-done (declared in tokens.css, lifted tones in tokens-dark.css, every value clearing the non-text 3:1 level on the header background in both themes) — instead of a raw hex, so the dot follows the theme. A collapsed column keeps its dot on the strip; a collapsed lane's slot carries the strip instead.

Touch drag (decision O7, plan 92e96b25): touch pointers drag through the shared pointer-drag.js helper via the tm-kanban.js module — a 400 ms long-press starts the drag (a tap and a page scroll keep working), the module paints the lifted card, the hovered zone and the insertion line without any Blazor re-render, and the ONE commit arrives on release through the same KanbanMoveEvent contract (the insertion index resolves by the midpoint rule against the other cards). pointercancel / Escape / a second finger roll back every paint and announce TmKanban_DragCancelled through the one polite live region. Mouse keeps the HTML5 drag path; the per-card "Move…" menu is the WCAG 2.5.7 alternative for every pointer.

The non-drag path is on by default because a drag-only card fails WCAG 2.5.7: one roving tab stop per cell, M / Alt+ArrowDown opens the move menu, Enter / Space raise OnCardClick, and the result is announced once through one polite live region.
Full behaviour contract: docs/kanban-board.md (layouts, collapsed zones, drop contract, colours, touch drag, a11y, data-testid set, localization keys, wireframe role, verification).

@task.Assignee

examples.title: Reorderable board persisting position
examples.code:
<TmKanbanBoard TItem="TaskItem"
               Items="@tasks"
               Columns="@columns"
               ColumnSelector="t => t.Status"
               CardTemplate="RenderCard"
               OnItemMoved="HandleMove"
               OnItemReordered="HandleMove" />

@code {
    void HandleMove(KanbanMoveEvent<TaskItem> e)
    {
        var moved = e.Item with { Status = e.ToColumn };
        tasks.RemoveAll(t => t.Id == e.Item.Id);
        var at = e.TargetBeforeItem is not null
            ? tasks.FindIndex(t => t.Id == e.TargetBeforeItem.Id)
            : tasks.Count;
        tasks.Insert(at < 0 ? tasks.Count : at, moved);
    }
}

examples.title: Swimlanes grouped by assignee
examples.code:
<TmKanbanBoard TItem="TaskItem"
               Items="@tasks"
               Columns="@columns"
               ColumnSelector="t => t.Status"
               SwimlaneSelector="t => string.IsNullOrEmpty(t.Assignee) ? null : t.Assignee"
               CardTemplate="RenderCard"
               OnItemMoved="HandleMove"
               OnItemReordered="HandleReorder" />

@code {
    // e.ToSwimlane is the target assignee (null = unassigned / "no value" lane)
    void HandleMove(KanbanMoveEvent<TaskItem> e)
        => Apply(e, e.Item with { Status = e.ToColumn, Assignee = e.ToSwimlane ?? "" });
}

examples.title: Keyboard / tap move (no drag)
examples.code:
<TmKanbanBoard TItem="TaskItem"
               Items="@tasks"
               Columns="@columns"
               ColumnSelector="t => t.Status"
               SwimlaneSelector="t => t.Assignee"
               CardLabelSelector="t => t.Title"
               CardTemplate="RenderCard"
               OnItemMoved="HandleMove"
               OnItemReordered="HandleReorder" />

@code {
    // Same contract as a drop: a menu move appends to the chosen (column, lane) cell and a
    // Move up / Move down reports the cell's new index. The card keeps the focus afterwards.
